source.author: Anastasia Kireeva
source.title: Low-degree hardness of finding the largest clique in Erdos-Renyi graph (problems 36-38)
source.target: conditions on (P_n,Q_n) under which bounded low-degree advantage through D=(log n)^{1+Omega(1)} rigorously limits a specified higher-degree polynomial distinguishing class

methods: B23 DO WHAT THE PROPOSER DID NOT EXPECT
B21 ASK WHO ELSE HAS THIS SHAPE
inherited_claim: The preceding route used noise-weighted covariance pressure plus a smoothed high-degree likelihood-tail condition, with leverage trimming allowing exceptional planted mass below low-degree resolution.

new_claim.definition: Sand_D(u;Q)=inf ||a||_{L2(Q)} over degree-<=D g,a with a>=0 and |u-g|<=a pointwise.
new_claim.theorem: If Q is stationary for Markov T and A=Adv_Q^{<=D}(P,Q)<infinity, then |E_{PT}f-E_Qf| <= A sqrt(Var_Q f) + (2+2A) Sand_D(Tf;Q).
new_claim.scope: This removes all planted high-degree likelihood-tail assumptions for a specified noised test class whose variance-sensitive low-degree sandwiching defect is controlled. It is a sufficient test-side framework, not an unrestricted solution of the source problem.
new_claim.strong_test_corollary: For [0,1] tests f_n with E_Q f_n->0, bounded source LDA and Sand_{D_n}(T_nf_n;Q_n)->0 imply E_{P_nT_n}f_n->0, hence no strong distinction.
new_claim.exact_matching_endpoint: When A=0, classical degree-D polynomial sandwiches recover |E_{PT}f-E_Qf| <= E_Q[p_+-p_-].

mao_boundary.consequence: For Mao's successful noised rank-test indicator, exact source LDA zero through D_n forces Sand_{D_n}(T_nf_n;Q_n) >= 1/2-o(1). Thus Mao violates the new condition on the test side for a substantive quantitative reason, complementary to the earlier persistent high-degree likelihood-energy obstruction.

prior_art_state: Sandwiching polynomials and bounded-independence-plus-noise are established prior art; Hsieh et al. 2601.05850 explicitly connect their program to that lineage. Novelty of the exact variance-sensitive bounded-LDA transfer statement and its source-directed synthesis remains UNVERIFIED.

recovery_state.reason: The run removes a material planted-tail assumption by a distinct test-side implication and derives a new quantitative Mao obstruction.

next_attack: Prove quantitative sandwiching-defect bounds for a meaningful structured test class of degree L_n>D_n, giving an explicit degree-amplification theorem rather than an abstract condition.
Develop a bulk-plus-nonnegative-tail-guard criterion that converts a typical-set approximant into a global L2 sandwich; target Boolean symmetric/Krawtchouk and Gaussian Hermite settings.
Extend the theorem from exactly Q-stationary noise to controlled adjoint defect and reconnect the weak-Gibbs/current theory without raw-Gram inversion.
Analyze Mao's rank acceptance set directly for an approximate-degree or dual-polynomial lower bound explaining its macroscopic sandwiching defect.
